semantic_cli_observations: appcenter-cli may emit [Error] while returning exit code 0
status returns noinstall for an absent application
appname length is constrained to 3-32 on the observed device
successful uninstall may leave smoke.log under @appdata, empty @appconf/@apphome/@appmeta directories, and a nologin package account
live_smoke.scoped_cleanup: verified smoke-only appdata containing exactly one regular smoke.log, empty appconf/apphome/appmeta directories, and verified smoke-only nologin package user/group

lifecycle_observations_2026_08_09.observation_mode: read-write lifecycle testing of the maintainer's own test applications on a user-provided device with explicit authorization; host identities, addresses and credentials intentionally omitted
application_shapes: native web app with wizard-managed ports
confirmed_behaviors: install_callback is killed after roughly 190 seconds; appcenter-cli install-fpk itself segfaults in that window
AppCenter never invokes cmd/main start; enabling an app only polls status
status returning non-zero inside the disable window is treated as APP_CRASH and can trigger automatic cleanup
manifest checkport=true makes a permanently resident entry port unstartable after disable (error 11000 / APP_START_FAILED_PORT_USAGE)
appcenter-cli install-fpk --env takes a KEY=VALUE file path, not an inline assignment
appcenter-cli start on a running app reports error 10500
uninstall semantics differ by app shape: VM disks in the libvirt pool survive, Docker images are removed, some native apps lose their configuration directory
fnpack rewrites manifest.checksum on every build and tar/gzip timestamps make whole-package hashes non-reproducible
newer fnpack releases require a three-segment manifest version

official desktop icon corners are a continuous-curvature squircle; profile reproduced exactly by icon_fit.py --style fnos-squircle from a full-bleed source (mid-row delta 0, x=0 opaque rows 125/256 on both)
corrected_beliefs: icon_fit.py does not inset the tile: the earlier inset came from artwork margins, because contain_square fits without cropping
assets/icon/official-squircle-mask-512.png is an anti-aliased alpha mask (mode L, corner alpha 0), not a fully opaque image
